(2025)}} | years_active = 2007–present | dates = Last Weekend/3 Days Of The Year | participants = [[Armin Van Buuren]], [[Above & Beyond (band)|Above & Beyond]], [[Ferry Corsten]], [[Axwell]], [[Shapeshifters]], [[Sander Van Doorn]] | genre = [[Electronic dance music]] | website = [http://sunburn.in/ sunburn.in] | logo = SunburnFestiveProperty.svg}} '''Sunburn Festival''' is a commercial [[electronic dance music]] festival held in India. It was started by entrepreneur [[Shailendra Singh (producer)|Shailendra Singh]]{{Cite web |last=Mahindru |first=Megha |date=2013-10-22 |title=Sunburn and the Indian EDM Explosion |url=https://rollingstoneindia.com/sunburn-and-the-indian-edm-explosion/ |access-date=2022-11-28 |website=Rolling Stone India |language=en-US}}{{Cite web |last=Chakraborty |first=Riddhi |date=2016-11-14 |title=Shailendra Singh: 'We're the Shah Rukh Khan of Dance Music Festivals' |url=https://rollingstoneindia.com/shailendra-singh-were-the-shah-rukh-khan-of-dance-music-festivals/ |access-date=2022-11-28 |website=Rolling Stone India |language=en-US}}{{cite book |last1=Singh |first1=Shailendra |title=The True Story of Sunburn |date=15 December 2014 |publisher=Embassy Books India; 1st edition |isbn=978-9383359738 |location=English, India |pages=20–23}} of Percept Ltd. Spanning over three to five days, the festival has multiple stages with artists playing simultaneously.{{cite web|title=Sunburn 2013: Goa gears up for Asia's Largest Music Festival|url=http://news.biharprabha.com/2013/12/sunburn-2013-goa-gears-up-for-asias-largest-music-festival/ | date=24 December 2013 |work=Biharprabha News|accessdate=16 May 2018}} It was held annually in [[Vagator]], [[Goa]] from 2007 to 2015, and shifted to [[Pune]], [[Maharashtra]] in 2016. In 2019, the festival returned to Vagator, Goa. According to a 2014 International Music Summit report, Sunburn was "as big as [[Tomorrowland (festival)|Tomorrowland]] and [[Ultra Music Festival|Ultra]]".{{cite web |last1=International Music Summit |title=IMS Business Report 2014: Asia-Pacific edition by Kevin Watson |url=https://www.internationalmusicsummit.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/07/ims-asia-pacific-business-report-2014.pdf |website=IMS APAC Report}} It was ranked by [[CNN]] in 2009 as one of the Top 10 Festivals in the world.[https://www.cnn.com/?_s=PM:TRAVEL CNN Article] {{Cite web |title=A guide to the world's best music festivals - CNN.com |url=https://edition.cnn.com/2009/TRAVEL/05/07/summer.festivals/index.html |access-date=2022-12-05 |website=CNN}} In 2011, Percept Ltd launched the Sunburn Arena, featuring [[Avicii]], at the Turf Club in Mumbai.{{Citation |title=Sunburn Arena with Avicii 2013 - Journey to the top (promo) | date=29 November 2013 |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KCmGHVz_C00 |language=en |access-date=2022-11-29}} In 2012, Percept launched Sunburn City Festival, Sunburn Campus and Sunburn Reload, as well as their first international festival, Sunburn Colombo.{{Cite web |last=IN |first=Rolling Stone |date=2012-10-03 |title=Q&A: Afrojack |url=https://rollingstoneindia.com/qa-afrojack/ |access-date=2022-11-28 |website=Rolling Stone India |language=en-US}}{{Cite news |archive-date=Nov 29, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221129172905/https://www.pressreader.com/sri-lanka/daily-mirror-sri-lanka/20120821/283115656115573 |url=https://www.pressreader.com/sri-lanka/daily-mirror-sri-lanka/20120821/283115656115573 |title=Sunburn Asia's Largest Music Festival to come to Sri Lanka |date=21 Aug 2012 |publisher=[[Daily Mirror (Sri Lanka)]] |language=en |access-date=24 July 2023 |via=[[PressReader]] |url-status=live}} Over the years Sunburn has expanded internationally and has included many well known DJs, including [[Swedish House Mafia]], [[Martin Garrix]], [[Hardwell]], [[David Guetta]], [[Axwell]], [[Dimitri Vegas & Like Mike|Dimitri Vegas and Like Mike]], [[Paul van Dyk|Paul Van Dyk]], [[Marshmello]], [[The |last=Mahindru |first=Megha |date=2013-10-07 |title=Deadmau5 To Tour India In 2014 |url=https://rollingstoneindia.com/deadmau5-to-tour-india-in-2014/ |access-date=2022-11-28 |website=Rolling Stone India |language=en-US}}{{Cite web |last=festivalsherpa |date=2013-05-16 |title=Quick Scoop: Shailendra Singh Named In Top 50 Most Powerful People in EDM |url=https://www.festivalsherpa.com/quick-scoop-shailendra-singh-named-in-top-50-most-powerful-people-in-edm/ |access-date=2022-11-29 |website=Sherpa Land |language=en-US}} ==History== Electronic music parties and similar festivals have been held in Goa, with the late 1980s seeing the start of [[Free party|free parties]], events that included DJs, art, crafts and food stalls. This continued through 1990s to early 2000s at beaches such as [[Vagator Beach Goa|Vagator Beach]], [[Anjuna|Anjuna beach]] and [[Arambol|Arambol beach]]. As of 2023, there have been 17 editions of the festival.{{Cite web |title=Sunburn Goa 2023: Unveiling a Spectacular Lineup and Enchanting Venue Experience |url=https://sunburn.in/sunburn-goa-2023-unveiling-a-spectacular-lineup-and-enchanting-venue-experience/ |access-date=2024-03-14 |language=en-GB}} ===2007 (Goa)=== In 2007, Shailendra Singh organized the first Sunburn as an international dance music festival. It took place on 28 and 29 December at [[Candolim|Candolim Beach]], Goa. Performers included [[Carl Cox]], [[Above & Beyond (band)|Above & Beyond]] and [[Axwell]] as headline acts. Held on two stages, with DJs playing simultaneously, other acts included [[John 00 Fleming]], Pete Gooding, DJ Pearl, Jalebee Cartel, Super 8 & Tab. The festival was hosted by [[Nikhil Chinapa]] and Rohit Barker. ===2008 (Goa)=== Sunburn Goa 2008 was themed Electric Circus and was held on two main stages: one for Trance acts and one for [[House music]]. Having tied up with [[Defected Records]] in 2008, the label brought house DJs Simon Dunmore, [[Shapeshifters]], Copyright and percussionist Shovel playing. Headlining the festival were [[GMS (music group)|GMS]], [[Gareth Emery]] and John 00 Fleming. The acts were Digital Blonde, Roger Shah, DJ Pearl, Brute Force, Nawed Khan, Vachan Chinnappa, Jalebee Cartel, Sanjay Dutta, and Ma Faiza. The event took place from 27 to 29 December at Candolim Beach. ===2010 (Goa)=== Sunburn Goa 2010 took place from 27 to 29 December at Candolim Beach. Sunburn passes went live on 5 November with the early bird passes and pre-booking sale passes being sold out in 22 minutes.{{cite web |url=http://www.ragatorock.com/hnews.asp?id=2307 |title=Raga to Rock - India's No.#1 Music Magazine |access-date=2011-08-04 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110929062454/http://www.ragatorock.com/hnews.asp?id=2307 |archive-date=29 September 2011 |df=dmy-all }} The headliners of the 2010 festival were [[Paul Van Dyk]], [[Ferry Corsten]] and [[Axwell]] along with [[Sultan & Ned Shepard]] with [[Nadia Ali (singer)|Nadia Ali]], [[Richard Durand]], [[GMS (music group)|GMS]], Pete Gooding, Aly & Fila and DJs Pearl, Ma Faiza, [[Anish Sood]] and Sanjay Dutta.{{citation needed|date=May 2022}} For the 2010 festival, Percept ran a "Sunburn Anthem Contest"Afternoon Articles http://www.afternoondc.in/48-hrs/burn-it-up/article_14722 for potential audio and visual producers, with participants in the visual category. ===2013 (Goa)=== [[File:Shraddha Kapoor snapped at sunburn festival.jpg|thumb|Shraddha Kapoor and [[Siddhanth Kapoor]] in Sunburn Goa 2013]] The 7th Edition of Sunburn took place in [[Vagator]]. This event had 7 stages and around 120 artists across 200 hours. Headline DJs were [[Afrojack]], [[Axwell]], [[Pete Tong]], [[Ummet Ozcan]]. ===2015 (Goa)=== The 9th edition was a 4-day event at Vagator, Goa. On 20 November 2015 Sunburn Goa's international ticketing partner, [[Viagogo]], announced that the festival has become one of the largest international music festivals in Asia,{{cite web | url=http://popdust.com/2015/11/20/sunburn-goa-become-largest-international-music-festival-asia/ | title=Sunburn Goa Has Become the Largest International Music Festival in Asia | date=20 November 2015 }} The artist lineup would have 120 artists, including [[Sam Feldt]], [[KYGO]], [[Seth Troxler]], [[Dimitri Vegas & Like Mike]], [[Martin Garrix]], DJ SMITH, [[KSHMR|Kshmr]], [[David Guetta]], [[Dyro]], [[Felix Jaehn]], [[Zaeden]] and Art Department.{{cite web |url=http://www.sify.com/news/sunburn-goa-announces-the-biggest-line-up-ever-with-4-massive-headliners-news-default-plytXEadgdbeg.html |title=Sunburn Goa announces the biggest line up ever with 4 massive |website=[[Sify]] |access-date=9 August 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151209170833/http://www.sify.com/news/sunburn-goa-announces-the-biggest-line-up-ever-with-4-massive-headliners-news-default-plytXEadgdbeg.html |archive-date=9 December 2015 |url-status=dead}} == Sunburn concerts in colleges == Multiple colleges across the country have hosted music festivals associated with Sunburn. These events are often part of the college's annual [[Cultural festival (India)|festivals]], usually called Sunburn Campus.{{Cite web |title=Sunburn Campus – Sunburn Festival |url=https://sunburn.in/sunburn-campus/ |access-date=2024-03-09 |language=en-US}}{{Cite web |title=Sunburn Campus Launch |url=https://everythingexperiential.businessworld.in/article/Percept-launches-Sunburn-Campus-Chatbox-to-inspire-the-Youth-of-India/15-06-2020-287342/#:~:text=Sunburn%20Campus%20is%20the%20popular,charts%20International%20and%20Domestic%20Artists. |website=Business World}} ==Gallery== File:Sunburn Festival, Goa, Back Stage.jpg File:Sunburn Festival, Goa, Lights and Sounds.jpg File:Sunburn Festival, Goa, Live performers in red light.jpg File:Sunburn Festival, Goa, Green lights.jpg File:Sunburn Festival, Goa, Progressive trance music.jpg File:Anish sood sunburn.jpg ==See also== {{Commons category}} *[[List of electronic music festivals]] * [[Music festival]] ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== * [http://sunburn.in/ official website] {{Electronic music festival}} {{coord missing|Goa}} [[Category:Music festivals established in 2007]] [[Category:Tourist attractions in North Goa district]] [[Category:Culture of Pune]] [[Category:Electronic music festivals in India]] [[Category:Festivals in Goa]] [[Category:Organised events in Pune]] [[Category:Music festivals in India]]
